The image shows soybean stems with:
- White fluffy/cottony mycelial growth on stems at nodes
- Prominent black sclerotia (hard, dark, irregularly shaped bodies) embedded in the white mold
- Bleached/white stem tissue
- Some brown/dead tissue adjacent to the lesion

This is a textbook presentation of White Mold (*Sclerotinia sclerotiorum*): the characteristic black sclerotia embedded within white fluffy mycelium on stem tissue is the defining diagnostic feature.
